result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 1 (General Provisions), Article 2, covering code-enforcement procedures (administrative enforcement orders, penalties, recordation of notices of violation, and mediation) rather than any rental housing rule.
result.notes: Despite the source URL pointing to the section on prohibition of anti-competitive automated rent price-fixing (SDMC 98.1103), the text in this part contains only general code-enforcement provisions (SDMC 12.0907-12.1105: enforcement orders, penalties, recordation of notices of violation, mediation). None of it states a rent increase limit, just cause eviction, security deposit, screening fee, screening restriction, or algorithmic rent-setting rule, so no records are extracted. The algorithmic rent-setting provision itself is not in this part and may appear in another part of the document.
